_note: SYNTHETIC demo data for the Harborvine billing-dispute demo. Not production; no real customer, bank or payment provider.

policies.text: Where the same invoice is captured more than once, the duplicate capture is refunded in full to the original payment method. A refund is issued only after Finance verifies the duplicate in the payment ledger.

Monthly uptime is 100% minus the share of 5-minute intervals in the month in which at least 5% of checkout requests failed. Below 99.9% the customer receives a service credit of 10% of the monthly fee; below 99.0%, 25%; below 95.0%, 100%. Credits below 1 USD are not paid.
Support must not confirm a refund or credit to a customer until Finance has executed it and the ledger shows it.
